_comment: Metabase groups and who is in them (D107). vm/metabase-setup.sh creates a Metabase account for every active Annex account that has a line in secrets/users.txt, with the name and email from the user directory, and puts it in the groups listed here under 'members'. Logins that are not listed get an account but no group; logins that do not exist (yet) are skipped. kaldi-admin is the Metabase admin.
